about.title: About Me
about.intro: Hi! I'm Diego, a passionate Senior Full Stack Developer currently working at INDRA, where I design and build scalable web solutions that solve real-world problems.
about.description1: With over 3 years of professional experience, I specialize in creating modern, performant web applications using technologies like React, Node.js, and Angular. My journey has taken me from developing AI-powered platforms at Deliryum.AI to architecting enterprise-level solutions at INDRA.
about.description2: I'm driven by clean code, user-centric design, and continuous learning. When I'm not coding, you'll find me exploring new technologies, contributing to open-source projects, or     sharing knowledge with the developer community.

indra.li1: CEN (Coordinador Eléctrico Nacional): evolution, maintenance and support of critical systems (Sistema de Correspondencia, Neomante, Operación Real, Project Management Platform, Estados Operativos, REUC) using Python, Django, Flask and FastAPI.
indra.li2: CEN: developed APIs, forms, console processes and email notifications; worked with MongoDB, PostgreSQL and MySQL; handled production deployments, server configuration and Nginx; resolved corrective tickets via ServiceTonic.
indra.li3: CODELCO: developed the Inspection and Testing Plan (PIE) module in PHP 7.4, including forms, document tracking and approval/rejection, progress control, process closures and exports to multiple formats.
indra.li4: ENEL – Emergency Management Platform (PGE): developed and evolved modules with .NET 9 / ASP.NET Core 9, Angular 15 and Oracle.
indra.li5: ENEL – PIP project: migrated a database from Oracle to PostgreSQL and developed, modified and migrated endpoints used by enel.cl.
indra.li6: ENEL: built .NET 8 console processes that extract data from PostgreSQL and send email notifications; deployed and maintained apps on Windows servers; fixed vulnerabilities reported by cybersecurity teams.

deliryum.li1: Developed Artificial Intelligence and computer vision solutions using YOLO and PyTorch.
deliryum.li2: Designed and built REST APIs with Python, Flask, FastAPI and Django.
deliryum.li3: Built web applications using React.js, JavaScript, HTML, CSS and Bootstrap.
deliryum.li4: Implemented and managed solutions on Microsoft Azure.
deliryum.li5: Sourced, prepared and managed image datasets for computer vision, including image selection, classification and labeling for model training.
